$comment: Chart labels (docs/specs/LOWER-THIRDS.md): what you learn at an island or a puzzle, and why. One text source for the game (src/learn/content/labels.ts) and the highlight reel (tools/video/reels/*.mjs can read it with fs and JSON.parse). Keys match the reel's lowerThird: k = small-caps label (place · activity), t = headline (what you learn), b = one line (why it matters), ch = the course chapter on the seal, c = the course section after 'Course Chapter <ch> · ', chLine = an optional override of 'Course Chapter <ch>'. source = the course section the text paraphrases (README anchor and its hash in content/course.lock.json). 'game' says where the game shows it: over an island's arrival, when a puzzle opens (once per save), or when a sea battle starts (once per save). A battle's id is its plan id (src/world/battle/battle.ts).

arrival:anchorage.t: Set up the GitHub Copilot app
arrival:anchorage.b: Connect your fork of the course, check your tools, and add the practice items that later chapters use.

arrival:meridian.t: Find your way around the app
arrival:meridian.b: Tour the app, then pick a chat or a project session, a mode, and a model and reasoning effort that fit the task.

arrival:thousand-bough.t: Give every task its own session
arrival:thousand-bough.b: A session has its own branch, diff and history, and its worktree keeps the changes out of your main checkout.

puzzle:P0.1.b: New forks start with workflows switched off. Turn them on before the setup script, so GitHub can run the practice checks.

puzzle:P0.2.b: With workflows on, run the setup script with --dry-run. Check that its Repository: line names your fork, then use --yes.

puzzle:P1.1.b: Chats are for questions and exploring. Use a project session when the agent needs your repository, even just to read it.

puzzle:P1.2.b: Read each order and pick the mode: step by step, plan first and review, or end to end. Then sail it that way.

puzzle:P1.3.k: Port Meridian · The Hall of Records
puzzle:P1.3.b: Open it with the gear at the bottom of the sidebar. Model providers adds providers. You still pick the model below the prompt box.

puzzle:P2.1.b: Each session gets its own worktree, so parallel sessions don’t mix their file changes. Then pick where each crew works.

puzzle:P2.2.b: Worktrees keep files and branches apart. Find out what two previews running side by side can still share.

puzzle:P2.3.b: A few special characters in the prompt box add context and commands. Bring only what the task needs: less is often more.

battle:passage-anchorage-meridian.b: Between waves, the bosun asks a question about what you just learned.

battle:passage-meridian-thousand-bough.k: The Passage to Thousand-Bough · Sea Battle
battle:passage-meridian-thousand-bough.b: Between waves, the bosun asks about Port Meridian: chats and project sessions, modes, and reasoning effort.
